messages:
customer-ops: Hey @support — customer in us-west1 is getting intermittent 429s when streaming completions. Request ID: abc123def456. They see the stream start then a 429 after ~10–15s. They tried a curl repro but it keeps failing. Can someone take a look?

sam: Can you paste the curl they ran (sanitized token) and the exact response headers they saw? 429 + any Retry-After header would be helpful.

customer-ops: Pasting the minimal repro they shared (token redacted):

```bash
curl -v 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  --http2 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-1","prompt":"hello","stream":true}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/
```

Response (headers):
HTTP/2 200
content-type: text/event-stream
content-length: -
x-request-id: abc123def456
... then after ~12s:
HTTP/2 429
content-type: application/json
retry-after: 30
{ "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "message": "Too many concurrent tokens" }

jen: Thanks — couple quick checks: 1) Are they multiplexing multiple streams over the same HTTP/2 connection? 2) Does their client retry on 429 or back off? 3) Which model/route was used and are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

customer-ops: They said single stream per client, hosted API, model rwd-llm-1, not using any custom backoff. Not on Dedicated.

sam: Two hypotheses: a) upstream rate-control triggered because token throughput spiked; b) a gateway side-per-client concurrency rule kicked in (we recently tightened some limits).

oncall-jordan: I can pull the gateway logs for that x-request-id. @jen can you ask them to run curl with --trace-ascii to capture the HTTP exchange and also attach a debug bundle? Prefer: `curl --trace-ascii debug.txt --http2 -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-1","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/`

jen: Also ask them to include the full response headers when the 429 happens. If they see a Retry-After we need that number. If it's 30s then gateway is signaling a transient throttle.

support-bot: Automated note: if collecting a debug bundle, please include: browser/agent string, client concurrency (streams per process), region, sdk version, and attach any curl --trace output. Prefer upload to secure bucket link or paste small files to the support ticket.

customer-ops: Uploaded debug bundle link: https://files.redwood.ai/support/bugs/1780523456-debug.zip (contains debug.txt with trace, client logs, and the curl command).

sam: I pulled the trace. Observations: the initial stream frames look fine, token throughput spikes around 11s, gateway returns 429 with header `x-rwd-quota: burst_exceeded` then `retry-after: 30`. This matches the customer's note.

jen: OK. Two follow-ups for the customer (can you relay?):
1) Short-term workaround: add exponential backoff on 429 + respect Retry-After header; if possible shard requests across multiple API keys/tenants or reduce token parallelism.
2) For us: @oncall-jordan can we check if a recent gateway config change adjusted per-conn token bursts? If so, we may need to tune for hosted customers on rwd-llm-1.

oncall-jordan: I'm checking the gateway config now. I see a change on 1780519000 that lowered burst tokens for HTTP/2 streams. Rolling back the param for this tenant group should stop these 429s. I'll stage a canary rollback and watch rate metrics for x-request-id abc123def456.

sam: Nice catch. Jen — can you confirm the customer applied the temporary backoff? If yes, ask them to test again and share the new trace.

customer-ops: Sent the backoff patch to the customer; they tested and stream now stays open for 60s without 429. They uploaded new trace: https://files.redwood.ai/support/bugs/1780523456-debug-2.txt

jen: Great. Marking this as customer-validated workaround. Action items:
- oncall-jordan: complete rollback canary and monitor for side effects (logs show quota bump).
- eng-infra: follow up to add better telemetry on per-conn bursting and surface to Console (so customers see when gateway enforces burst limits).

oncall-jordan: Canary rollback completed at 1780523600. Early metrics look good; no increase in error rate. Leaving monitoring alert for 2 hours.

sam: Thanks everyone. Closing thread once eng-infra tickets created. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket update: linked internal issue INFRA-2134 created to add per-conn burst visibility in Console.

customer-ops: Customer confirmed they're unblocked. Thanks team!
